content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. It is stated that the TP700 panel does not have WLAN, but if I purchase a wireless USB stick and plug it into the TP700, am I able to establish wireless communication with the [company_name] [product_name] over that wireless network? [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking whether adding a generic wireless USB stick to the TP700 operator panel can provide WLAN connectivity and allow wireless communication with a [company_name] [product_name]. The question reveals uncertainty around the documentation or support for wireless features and the compatibility of external USB peripherals on the TP700 panel for interacting wirelessly with [company_name] automation devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that connecting a third-party wireless USB stick to the TP700 panel will enable WLAN functionality, making it possible to wirelessly communicate with a [company_name] [product_name].
